items.title: Remote sessions survive sleep
items.text: Closing your laptop no longer kills remote shells: sessions now live for 24 hours instead of 5 minutes, and Ghoztty reconnects the moment your network comes back, with a Connecting indicator and a Reconnect button on the machine pill.

items.title: Windows agent installer, fixed and polished
items.text: The installer is now versioned like the app (`Ghoztty-Agent-1.12.0-x64.msi`), shows its version in Apps & Features and in the file's properties, starts the agent immediately after install (and at every logon), and cleanly retires older installs — including the pre-MSI setup that could silently keep an outdated agent running.

items.title: Rename windows with ⌘⇧R
items.text: Window rename now has a default keyboard shortcut.

items.title: No more freeze when closing terminals
items.text: Closing a window or pane whose process was slow to exit could beachball the whole app; it can't anymore.
